stories.headline: BJP chief Nabin asks oppn to follow Advani's approach to national security
stories.title: BJP chief Nabin asks oppn to follow Advani's approach to national security
stories.summary: BJP president Nitin Nabin highlighted L K Advani's legacy during a special event for his 100th birthday. He urged opposition parties to unite during national security challenges, following Advani's example. Nabin credited Advani and Atal Bihari Vajpayee for the BJP's growth from its early years to its current prominence. The significance of Advani's contributions to the Ram Janmabhoomi movement was also recognized at the event.

stories.headline: Sonia Gandhi turned to Bhagavad Gita to resolve dilemma over politics
stories.title: Sonia Gandhi turned to Bhagavad Gita to resolve dilemma over politics
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi "always disliked" politics and was at war with herself over whether she should take the plunge into the political world after her husband Rajiv Gandhi's assassination, but the Bhagavad Gita helped resolve her doubts and showed her the path forward. The former Congress chief, while talking about the internal conflict and turmoil she went through in the years before her active foray into politics, says in her new book that as the party was facing a challenging time in the late 1990s, each time she walked past Rajiv's picture and that of her mother-in-law Indira Gandhi's, a mixture of pain and guilt would seize her. She recalled how her children, Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, "argued fiercely" with her as they feared she might allow herself to get drawn into politics and "they didn't want to lose me, too". stories.headline: NCR Pollution | 'Lungs Of Even Children In Delhi Not Pink', Amicus Tells Supreme Court
stories.title: NCR Pollution | 'Lungs Of Even Children In Delhi Not Pink', Amicus Tells Supreme Court
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: In the matter relating to air pollution in Delhi-NCR, the Supreme Court recently expressed that Court intervention on the issue should be limited, else people would be tempted to violate the laws.
Instead, pollution awareness programmes can be made part of Diwali programmes.
During the hearing, the Court was told about the report of a Ganga Ram Hospital chest surgeon that in Delhi, even the lungs of children are not pink.
However, it said that it was not inclined to go into "anecdotal" opinion.
The Court said that it will go by expert view and GRAP opinion, unless any research work to the contrary, from a peer-reviewed journal, is presented.
"We have reason to believe that CAQM takes into consideration all expert opinion, including health professionals...whether the lungs of a young child is better in adaptation, we have no [knowledge].
Whatever GRAP says, unless you can rebut it with peer reviewed research papers, we are not going to go into these persuasive arguments", said Justice Joymalya Bagchi.
A bench of CJI Surya Kant, Justice Bagchi and Justice V Mohana initially expressed that it will issue certain directions and call for compliance by the states/UTs.
Later it said it will call for reports and updates from the concerned authorities.
At the outset, the CJI remarked, "We hope all of you are enjoying Delhi weather".
